newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice not traded for second day.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice not traded for second day.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures did not trade for a second day on Thursday because investors had lost interest in trading with the approach of the National Day holiday, traders said.
Traders said long and short position holders had offset most of their positions after delivery of the September contract.
"Many retail investors lost heavily in the September contract because institutions had dominated the market," one trader said.
China's National Day holiday will last for five days from September 28 to October 2. Trading will resume on October 3.
"Investors wanted to move their money to more active markets including the stock market," the trader said.
Traders said investors did not want to trade with the approach of the National Day holiday. They expect rice to trade in thin volume after the holiday.
